settings.heading: Why do big-name wedges cost what they do?
settings.lede: Most of it isn't the wedge. It's the tour contract, the shop that stocks it, and everybody in between.

settings.line: Forged, gold, and a face that grabs the ball like it owes it money.
The same forged head, blacked out, with the gold clover left on.

settings.heading: Their wedge next to ours.
settings.sub: We're not naming names, because this isn't about one company. It's how the whole shelf is priced.
settings.after: Look at the head and the face. Those are the parts that hit the ball, and they're not where the markup goes.

settings.label: Wedge head
settings.them: Carbon steel, cast or forged by model

settings.label: Wedge face
settings.us: CNC-milled grooves and a micro-grooved face

settings.label: Sole grinds
settings.us: K and S on gold, K on black

settings.label: Trying it
settings.them: A few swings in the shop
settings.us: Sixty days, and you can hit one on a mat

settings.heading: Where the extra money goes.
settings.after: We don't have any of those, so none of it got added in the first place. It's not a sale. There's just less in there.

settings.title: The tour contract
settings.text: Somebody's getting paid to have that wedge in the bag on Sunday. That money's in the price you pay.

settings.title: The shop
settings.text: Floor space, staff and rent, in a building you've got to drive to, and the club's carrying all of it.

settings.title: Everybody in between
settings.text: A distributor sits between the factory and the shop, and takes a cut on the way past.

settings.eyebrow: Don't take our word for it
settings.heading: Check it yourself.

settings.title: Sixty days on clubs
settings.text: Hit one on a mat. Not feeling it? Send it back.

settings.title: Ships in 1 to 2 days
settings.text: Tracking shows up as soon as the carrier scans it.

settings.name: Adam K.
settings.quote: Took a chance on these wedges and have been very pleasantly surprised at their appearance, performance and durability. Would definitely recommend for someone looking for a solid wedge and doesn’t want to pay the price for the large and popular brands and doesn’t have the need or want to get fitted!

settings.quote: Great looks and performance for the price

settings.heading: “It's better to be lucky.”
